evidence.locator: Network architecture and access; public services paragraph
evidence.quote: Default policy denies unlisted inter-zone traffic and unsolicited inbound Internet traffic. Public services use documentation addresses: portal 192.0.2.10:443, VPN 192.0.2.20:443 and partner SFTP 192.0.2.30:22. No public RDP, SMB, LDAP, SQL or management interface is published.

Northbridge Services has 1,000 staff: 700 assigned to headquarters, 150 to a branch and 150 working remotely. Its applications support customer service, orders, invoicing and payroll. A recovery site hosts infrastructure and replicated data. The company uses one Active Directory forest and domain, corp.northbridge.example, synchronized to one Microsoft Entra tenant.
S02 network design and reviewed access policy | Unlisted inter-zone traffic and unsolicited Internet ingress denied by default. No Internet-facing RDP, SMB, LDAP, SQL or appliance management.
S04 telemetry coverage summary | AD authentication, Microsoft 365 audit, firewall and VPN logs retained online for 90 days. Twelve E02 endpoint sensor heartbeats are older than seven days.

S05 business impact and recovery worksheet | Identity outage can block new logins across 1000 staff; existing sessions may continue temporarily. ERP supports 300 daily operations staff; outages beyond four hours delay orders and invoicing.

evidence.locator: Endpoints appliances and cloud services; additional devices paragraph
evidence.quote: Additional devices: 40 managed wireless APs (N11) and 30 printers (P01). Appliance firmware and precise patch builds are unknown. HQ has two firewalls in an active/passive pair; the branch and recovery site each have one. The HQ VPN and WAF each have active/standby pairs.

evidence.locator: Technical Details; paragraph beginning The vulnerability CVE-2024-21762
evidence.quote: The vulnerability CVE-2024-21762 [1], with a CVSS score of 9.8, is due to incorrect parameter checks in FortiOS SSL-VPN. When exploited by a remote and unauthenticated attacker via crafted HTTP requests, a reduced number of bytes could be copied outside buffer bounds, leading to memory corruption and flow redirection. This allows execution of arbitrary code or command.

quote.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS contains an out-of-bound write vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute code or commands via specially crafted HTTP requests.
quote.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

assumptions: High impact is a policy interpretation of the production remote-access role, pending analyst review.
limitations: DOCX-derived subset; companion JSON/CSV/lookup script were not supplied.
The original DOCX documents public VPN TCP/443 but does not identify SSL-VPN termination or enabled status; fixture values are explicit simulated overrides.
No per-gateway state, configuration date, exact internal flows, or VPN-specific RTO is supplied.
No telemetry events establish actual exploitation or compromise.

confidence.reason: Synthetic environment and pending human review; confidence is not a numeric probability.

C-POLICY.text: Applicable Internet-reachable service with major business consequences.

C-SCOPE.text: One explicitly simulated N02 test instance; does not assert the state of both cohort members; all local evidence is simulated.

C-VERSION.text: Affected-version comparison: True; exact input and source ranges are preserved.

C-IMPACT.text: Business impact is High; this is a policy interpretation of the cited business context, not observed compromise.

C-KEV.text: CISA catalog lookup reports known exploitation; it does not establish local compromise.

A-PATCH.text: Upgrade through the vendor-supported path to a currently supported release fixed for this CVE; coordinate gateway failover and change approval. Historical test version 7.2.7 is not a current deployment recommendation.

A-LOGS.text: Review retained VPN, firewall and identity logs for suspicious activity; escalate actual findings to incident response. No compromise is asserted by this assessment.

evidence_needed_to_change_decision: Dated firmware, component state, supported route/exposure, and business-dependency evidence for the assessed scope; version/configuration changes or reconciled contradictions trigger reassessment.
